envelope.description: Preserve admission failures in reports and approval readers

body.title: Preserve admission failures in reports and approval readers
body.summary: Extend current code/design history, publication, completion and approval-preservation readers to represent technical admission failures without fabricated task/chunk assessments. Normalize mutable resourceGuard metadata consistently for publication preservation identity while retaining durable audit receipts and unchanged reviewed-content/approval bindings.
acceptanceChecks: Technical admission failures remain visible across failed admission, next successful attempt, permanent publication and post-cleanup history reads for both families.
Only independently passed, qualified current whole-story/artifact evidence permits approval; unverified admission or clearance cannot satisfy a gate.
Resource-only lease/receipt changes do not invalidate published review identity or lose prior approval evidence; lost-publication-receipt replay is idempotent.
No history reader replays models or silently drops unsupported records.
Changing reviewed input/source/result fields still invalidates preservation identity; normalization excludes only explicitly mutable operational guard metadata while retaining its audit record.

tests.name: src/workflow/code-review/task-review/__tests__/admission-history.test.ts: failed admission survives successful next attempt publication and post-cleanup reads
src/workflow/review/design-review/__tests__/admission-history.test.ts: technical admission diagnostics remain non-review evidence across publication
src/workflow/code-review/task-review/__tests__/resource-preservation.test.ts: guard-only updates preserve report identity while reviewed-input or result mutations do not
